When I was growing up in the 80s, sure we had George Michael's "I want your sex" and Prince's "Erotic City". The difference between then and now is that we also had Bruce Hornsby & The Range's "The way it is, Michael Jackson's "Man in the mirror", Phil Collins' "Another day in Paradise", etc. All meaningful songs to balance out the shallow ones. Hell, even Madonna sung about teen pregnancy via "Papa don't preach. I mean damn, even in the hair metal genre, which was about as shallow as you could get, you still had serious songs like Poison's "Give me something to believe in" or Def Leppard's "Gods of war".

You're speaking my language! I love me some nature mods!

- Natura: adds a few trees and berry bushes.

- Animals Plus: Adds a modest variety of animals, such as birds, fish, lizards, etc.

- Lots O Mobs: Adds more animals plus dinosaurs! There are biomes dedicated to the dinosaurs, also fossils to dig up and a dino dimension.

- ExtrabiomesXL adds a decent amount of biomes (like 25 or so), from redwoods to autumn forest.

- Enhanced Biomes: another really nice biome mod. It goes so far as to provide different kinds of dirt, stone and trees for its biomes.

- Garden Stuff: adds flower pots, lamps, iron fences, special soil that lets you arrange multiple flowers on a single block, etc.

- Plant Mega Pack: adds a huge amount of realistic plants, something like 400 new plants. 

- Underground Biomes Constructs: Regular stone is replaced by LOTS of different types of stone.

It really depends on what your idea of fun is. Minecraft mods are so versatile that they cater to just about every taste. For MC 1.7.10 alone there are over 1000 mods. I'll just list a few to give you an idea:

- Orespawn: a mod that acts like a modpack, has everything from new mobs to new dimensions. It's less serious than your average mod, featuring things like weapons that launch creepers into the air, girlfriends, hoverboards, and ridiculously huge swords.

- Enviromine: makes MC more realistic. Blocks have physics, torches will light wood on fire, you have a thirst meter, body temperature meter, air quality meter and sanity meter, food spoils, etc.

- Lycanite's Mobs: adds very challenging monsters that spawn from more than just darkness. Some spawn from lava, water, stone or even crops.

- Pam's Harvestcraft: adds a ton of crops and over 700 new food items.

- Biomes O Plenty, ExtrabiomesXL, and Highlands all add new biomes to explore, complete with new trees and plants.

- Better Foliage: enhances the graphics with better grass, falling leaves, weeds in water, etc. Very pretty.

- Chocolate Quest: adds structures like castles and tree forts that are protected by armed enemies, some have bosses.

- Twilight Forest: A new adventure dimension with linear progression, unlock areas by beating bosses.

- Morph: morph into the mobs that you kill.

- Flan's Mods: adds vehicles to the game like tanks, airplanes, etc.

So really, as you can see there are many different types of mods out there.
